analysis: Exp14 / paper-E7 MRL expression-oracle certification (reset run; retained E7 2026-08-11 re-registered)

anchor_set.source: Sample et al. 2019 MPRA (Nat Biotechnol 37:803), GEO GSE114002
anchor_set.convention: DNA anchor sequences verbatim; tool-layer production normalization (uppercase, T→U) before the service — 'DNA scored as RNA', service echo recorded per call

conventions.instrument: ToolExecutor.run_tool (ToolRegistry, schema-validated .invoke) -> deployed GEMORNA microservice as shipped
conventions.gpu_map: deployed instance GPU-pinned 0/1/2 by the bring-up script; placement inherited, untouched — zero intervention
conventions.zero_intervention: anchor entries verbatim; default tool arguments only; no threshold presets; no in-run retries (resume only)

gates.screening: AUROC > 0.8 (strict), stratified bootstrap 95% CI must clear chance for the certification reading

conventions.bootstrap: percentile 95% CI, 10000 resamples, seed 0 (rho CI descriptive — not gate-bearing)
conventions.positive_control: sample2019_egfp_random50 is in-training-distribution; its pass certifies the deployed chain, not generalization

decision_bits: Random 50-nt (in-distribution): AUROC 0.9903 (CI [0.9754, 1.0]) gate > 0.8: PASS; rho +0.9256 (CI [0.8835, 0.9489]) gate >= 0.6: PASS [retained 0.990 / 0.926]
Varying-length random: AUROC 1.0000 (CI [1.0, 1.0]) gate > 0.8: PASS; rho +0.9201 (CI [0.874, 0.9467]) gate >= 0.6: PASS [retained 1.000 / 0.920]
Varying-length human: AUROC 1.0000 (CI [1.0, 1.0]) gate > 0.8: PASS; rho +0.8353 (CI [0.7479, 0.8973]) gate >= 0.6: PASS [retained 1.000 / 0.835]
E7 verdict (all three families × both gates): GO — MRL oracle certified (verified/verified) on all families; random50 read as the in-distribution positive control
